subject: MAP: Technical evaluation plan and success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@elara-ai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: MAP items + technical eval milestone (next steps)

Thanks again for the call today, Jordan — great discussion and super helpful context on Elara's latency targets and procurement cadence. Per our agreement on the call, I'm sending a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the technical evaluation milestone. The goal here is to make the technical eval actionable and timeboxed so both teams know responsibilities and success criteria.

Quick recap of what we heard on the call:
- Evaluation scope: end-user chat latency and throughput for 8k-context, token-generation use cases; embedding throughput for semantic search; deterministic cost-per-1M-tokens baseline.
- Targets you mentioned: 95th percentile latency <= 350ms on 1-2 token responses in our UAT env; average cost delta vs current provider <= 25%.
- Success criteria will require model shortlist (open models + Redwood variants), benchmark harness, and an agreed pass/fail for latency/cost + quality.

Attached is a draft MAP & tech-eval plan (MAP-technical-eval-draft-20260614.pdf) and a latency test plan spreadsheet. Highlights from the draft MAP (please review):
- Milestone: Technical evaluation complete
  - Target close date: 2026-07-09
  - Owner (customer): Jordan Ellis (Elara AI) — provide dataset samples + PII guidance
  - Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao — deliver benchmark harness, run baseline tests, provide model config suggestions
  - Dependencies: access to sample corpus, account provisioned in Redwood Private/Dedicated test pool, NDA and SOC2 evidence as needed
  - Success criteria (pass if ALL met):
    1) 95th pct latency <= 350ms for single-turn replies at 8k context on test harness,
    2) token-generation cost no more than 25% higher than Elara's current provider for equivalent throughput,
    3) redwood model outputs meet quality baseline (BLEU/ROUGE-style checks + small human eval)

Next steps: please confirm the owners and target close date or propose adjustments. Once we lock this, Aditya will schedule the initial benchmark run and we can loop in procurement for any necessary account setup.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: MAP-technical-eval-draft-20260614.pdf (PDF, 1 page stub), latency-test-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP items + technical eval milestone (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick confirmations/questions from our side:
1) Target close date: 2026-07-16 would be safer for us given internal release windows — are you flexible by one week?
2) For data: we'll be able to share 20 sample conversations (de-identified) by 6/18. Will that be sufficient for an initial run?
3) Latency target is mostly for user-facing short replies; 95th <= 350ms sounds reasonable. For long-form generation (50+ tokens) we can relax to 800ms 95th. Can you reflect that in the success criteria?

Also looping our procurement lead for account provisioning. We're excited to move forward.

— Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Product, Elara AI
jordan.ellis@elara-ai.com

Subject: Draft: Technical MAP milestone — bench plan & responsibilities

Hi Jordan / team — thanks for the quick confirmation. I've updated the MAP draft to reflect Jordan's note on relaxing long-form 95th to 800ms. Attaching the updated benchmark plan (latency-test-plan.xlsx) and included a short checklist in this email for clarity.

Bench plan summary:
- Harness: Redwood bench harness (Docker-based) configured for 8k-context tests. Runs: single-turn short replies (1-3 tokens target) and long-form (50+ tokens).
- Models to include (shortlist):
  1) Redmond-7B-quant (Redwood-optimized)
  2) LlamaX-13B-q4 (open)
  3) Falcon-40B-instruct-8k (open)
  4) Redmond-13B-fp16 (if GPU memory permits)
- Metrics: 95th percentile latency (ms), avg cost per 1M tokens (USD), throughput (tokens/sec), quality pass rate (human eval sample and automated similarity metrics).
- Data: use the 20 de-identified conversations + 5 canonical prompts from Elara.
- Environment: Redwood dedicated test pool (us-west), single-region to match your UAT latency profile.

Checklist / responsibilities:
- Jordan (Elara): provide data samples by 2026-06-18, confirm PII scrub guidance, and provide a contact for test account setup (procurement lead OK).
- Aditya (Redwood): provision bench harness, run initial baseline within 48 hours of data receipt, provide raw logs and summary report within 72 hours of run completion.
- Rishi (Redwood AE lead): coordinate any contractual questions and SOC2 evidence requests.
- Marissa: oversee MAP timeline and sync weekly status.

Dependencies noted: test account provisioning, network whitelisting for Redwood test pool, acceptance of minimal DPA addendum (procurement). If any of these block, flag immediately so we can escalate.

I'll push the updated MAP PDF to the Drive link Marissa shared and schedule an initial bench-run kickoff on 6/19 pending your confirmation.

— Aditya Rao
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

2) For quality checks: can we include a small human eval rubric (3 raters, 5 prompts each) that we can run in parallel?

If those are doable, greenlight us for the 6/19 kickoff.

— Jordan
